app.subtitle: Bulk video downloader — profiles & single links
links.hint:
Paste many links at once — profiles and single videos together:
https://www.tiktok.com/@profile
https://www.facebook.com/username/videos
https://www.instagram.com/reel/xxxxxxxx/
links.note: Profiles are expanded automatically and every video is tagged with the profile it came from.
links.fetch_limit_hint: Leave empty to fetch every video from a pasted profile link, or set a number to only fetch that many most-recent videos.
output.per_profile_folder: Save each profile in its own folder
output.per_profile_folder_hint: Videos are saved into <download folder>/<profile>/ instead of one shared folder.
naming.example: Live example of what will be saved
naming.sidecar_note: The .txt file keeps the original title and the full metadata.
naming.no_txt_note: Tick the box below if you also want a .txt metadata file.
quality.label: Video quality
perf.mode_both: Both: GPU decoding plus every CPU core for FFmpeg.
perf.mode_cpu: CPU: FFmpeg uses every available core.
perf.mode_gpu: GPU: FFmpeg uses hardware acceleration when available.
perf.mode_none: FFmpeg runs with its default settings.
perf.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg not found — 1080p+ merging and mp3 conversion are unavailable. Use "Locate ffmpeg…" or add it to PATH.
cookies.hint: Facebook and Instagram usually need cookies from a browser you are logged into.
finish.shutdown: Shut down the PC when everything is done
finish.shutdown_hint: A 60-second warning appears first and can always be cancelled.
finish.shutdown_armed: Shutdown armed — you can still cancel it when the countdown appears.
timer.title: Estimated time remaining
table.title: Title
table.empty: The queue is empty. Paste links on the left, then press “Add to queue”.
log.title: Activity log
dialog.disclaimer_body: TK Downloader is provided for personal and educational use only.
dialog.disclaimer_points:
•  Download only content you own or have permission to save.
•  Respect each platform's Terms of Service and your local copyright law.
•  Do not redistribute downloaded material without the owner's consent.
•  You alone are responsible for how you use this software.
dialog.resume_body: {count} unfinished download(s) from {profiles} profile(s) were found from your last session.
dialog.resume_hint: Videos that already finished are never downloaded twice — the download archive keeps track of them.
dialog.shutdown_title: The PC is about to shut down
dialog.shutdown_body: All downloads are finished. The computer will shut down when the countdown reaches zero.
dialog.clear_all_body: Every item is removed from the list. Files already saved on disk are kept.
msg.no_links: Paste at least one link first.
msg.paused: Paused. Partial files are kept so downloads can resume.
msg.cleared_finished: Finished items removed from the list.
msg.resumed: Resumed {count} item(s) from the previous session.
msg.play_failed: Couldn't open that video — the file may have been moved or deleted.
